hints.title: Root Left Right Order
hints.text: Record current node value before processing descendants in the left subtree, followed by descendants in the right subtree.

hints.title: Right-Before-Left Stack Ordering
hints.text: When using an explicit stack, push the right child before the left child so that the left child is popped and processed first.

hints.title: Iterative Preorder Traversal
hints.text: Initialize stack with root if non-null. While stack is not empty, pop the top node, append its value to results, then push right child if present, and left child if present.

complexity.notes: Optimal linear traversal visiting every node once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive list concatenation at each frame introduces quadratic O(N^2) copying overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Explicit stack traversal achieves O(H) auxiliary space without recursion depth limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Push right child before left child on an explicit stack for correct preorder sequencing.
